public_rationale: Before the post, Core Scientific publicly described a commissioned 16 MW HPC deployment serving CoreWeave. That is meaningful evidence of commercial operating capacity. It does not establish that the much larger contracted expansion was already operational.
limitations: The outcome depends on treating a commercial 16 MW deployment as meaningful.
This assesses available public evidence, not what the author personally found.
Hosting capacity does not imply ownership of the customer's GPUs.

conditions: based on the author's own search

statement.excerpt: In fact, I can find little proof that Core Scientific has any meaningful compute capacity at all.

from_speaker: any meaningful compute capacity at all
our_interpretation: Assess the public evidence available to the author, rather than his private search effort.
In context, compute means operational AI or HPC hosting infrastructure; Bitcoin hashing capacity alone does not count.
Meaningful means a commercial operating deployment, rather than an announcement or demonstration. It does not require completion of the entire planned expansion.
Use fiscal 2024, the latest complete annual reporting period before publication, to assess documented operational capacity.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous disclosures provide only proposed capacity, Bitcoin mining capacity, or small demonstrations, without documenting a commercial operating HPC deployment.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Public disclosures before the post document a commercial operating HPC deployment at Core Scientific.
